OPPO K14x 5G Smartphone, Prism Violet, 4GB RAM, 128GB Storage

Product description

The Oppo K14x 5G smartphone in stunning Prism Violet combines style with performance to deliver an exceptional mobile experience. This sleek device features a captivating gradient finish with geometric patterns that catch the light beautifully, making it a true statement piece. Equipped with 4GB RAM and 128GB internal storage, the K14x provides ample space for your apps, photos, videos, and files whilst ensuring smooth multitasking capabilities. The dual-camera system on the rear captures your precious moments with clarity and detail, whilst the front-facing camera is perfect for selfies and video calls. The expansive display offers an immersive viewing experience with minimal bezels and a punch-hole design, ideal for streaming content, gaming, or browsing. With 5G connectivity, you'll enjoy lightning-fast download speeds and seamless streaming. The modern design features a comfortable grip and premium build quality that feels great in hand. Whether you're a content creator, mobile gamer, or simply need a reliable daily driver, the Oppo K14x 5G delivers the features and performance you need at an accessible price point.
